question: What was the theme of the 8th Indian Ocean Conference?

options.text: Voyage to New Horizons of Maritime Partnership
Sustainable Development in the Indian Ocean

solution:
The correct answer is __**Voyage to New Horizons of Maritime Partnership**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The theme of the 8th Indian Ocean Conference was **Voyage to New Horizons of Maritime Partnership**.
 
• The event focused on fostering collaboration among Indian Ocean Region (IOR) nations to ensure maritime security, economic growth, and sustainable development.
 
• It emphasized the importance of strengthening maritime partnerships for regional stability and global peace.
 
• The Indian Ocean Conference serves as a key platform for dialogue on geopolitical and economic challenges in the Indian Ocean Region.
 
• The conference brought together policymakers, academics, and industry leaders from across the globe to address pressing maritime issues.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Ocean Region (IOR)**

 
 
• The Indian Ocean Region is a strategically significant area encompassing 38 countries bordering the Indian Ocean.
 
• It is vital for global trade, with nearly half of the world's container traffic passing through it.
 
• The region plays a crucial role in energy security, as it connects major oil-producing nations to energy-consuming markets.
 
 
 
• **Maritime Security**
 
 
• Maritime security refers to measures taken to protect seas and oceans from threats like piracy, terrorism, and illegal fishing.
 
• It ensures safe navigation, trade, and sustainable use of marine resources.
 
 
 
• **Blue Economy**
 
 
• The Blue Economy involves the sustainable use of ocean resources for economic growth, improved livelihoods, and ocean ecosystem health.
 
• Key sectors include fisheries, aquaculture, maritime transport, renewable energy, and tourism.
 
 
 
• **Indian Ocean Conference**
 
 
• The Indian Ocean Conference was first held in 2016 and has become a significant forum for discussing regional challenges.
 
• The conference aims to enhance cooperation among Indian Ocean states and stakeholders.
